summary: On 21 January 1998 President Lee Teng-hui promulgated the Law on the Territorial Sea and the Contiguous Zone (12-nm territorial sea, baselines to be set by the Executive Yuan and announced in batches) and the Law on the Exclusive Economic Zone and the Continental Shelf (200-nm EEZ in which the ROC claims sovereign rights over resources and jurisdiction over artificial islands, marine research and the environment, with fines and confiscation for unpermitted fishing or research), the legal basis for the ROC's maritime claims around the Pratas and Spratlys.

The draft 'historic waters' language debated since 1992 does not appear in the enacted text.
